note.p: There are only fifteen appearances of 'Fraser' in the diary from 1788 - 32, and none of the candidates from the DNB seem convincing. The earliest appearances are all at Thomas Brand Hollis's, and suggest strong links with the Society for Constitutional Information, which suggests Alexander Fraser (who dies 1793) - that is: Alexander Fraser (Lord Saltoun of Abernethy) born 27.6.1758 son of George Fraser (died 1781) and Eleanor Gordon. Admitted Lincolns Inn 24.11.1779. Advocate (Scotland) 5.8.1780. At Strasbourg on way to Lausanne 26.3.1783. Married 9.6.1784 Marjory only dau of Simon Fraser of Ness Castle, Co. Inverness, London merchant and director of East India Co. Died 13.9.1793 at Baldwin, Kent of gout in stomach. Lord Saltoun proposed member 9.5.1788 by Hugh Sempill 2nded John Cartwright

The last entries are likely to be to James Balie Fraser. The middle entries remain a puzzle. It is likely that later entries do not refer to the same person - and might refer to James Ballie Fraser (see entry).
